note: THESE ARE FRAGMENTS, NOT INDEPENDENT MODULES. scripts/selftest.py compiles each file listed here and executes it into shared.py's ONE namespace, in the order given, so every fragment sees exactly the state the monolith gave it. None of them runs standalone: a name one fragment rebinds is visible to every later one, and scripts/suite_equiv.py over this manifest returns DEFECTIVE, reporting every fragment PASSES_IN_AGGREGATE_FAILS_ALONE and the reversed order ORDER_DEPENDENT, which is why the order in this file is the contract. Standalone independence is a separate item, and nothing in the gate runs suite_equiv over these files. A file present in this directory and absent from this list turns the gate RED as SUITE_NOT_ENUMERATED rather than silently not running. VELDO_SUITE_ORDER reorders the run as a diagnostic and accepts the same name twice, which RUNS that suite twice and inflates the printed count; it can never SHRINK the run, so it cannot hide a skipped suite or fabricate a pass.
